svg.text: One USB-C port (the QT Py’s) programs the board, powers it and charges the battery.
Dashed wires are participant connections. Copper bar: both screws in BAT, 5V and GND are tied. SW screws are separate.
USB in: USB → QT Py 5V → 5V block → charger. Diode blocks the battery.
Battery: BAT → diode → SW → switch → SW → 5V block → QT Py 5V.
